name: Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit
tier_rationale: Established network operator with published terms; P057 cond 5: 'trusted - bgp.he.net (Hurricane Electric)'.

reliability.justification: Routing data (origin AS, prefixes, peers) for manual review; automation uses RIPEstat/Team Cymru.

pivot_pages.title: bgp.he.net IP, prefix and AS pages (manual pivot links; never scraped)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

pivot_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (cond 1 of the proposal). Research C0129. /ip/{ip} and /AS{asn} verified (200). Prefix pages need a literal '/': /net/8.8.8.0%2F24 answers 404, /net/8.8.8.0/24 answers 200 (verified 2026-11-26), so the prefix link is rendered by pivots_ip_network with the vetted {cidrp} encoder. Never scraped (anti-bot; P057 cond 8). Used by pivots_ip_network (pack ip_network.json).

notes: Manual pivot links only (batch p2-G14-1): V3LUM never fetches them (P311).
